definitions.explanation: A child enrolled in a kindergarten or nursery school. Used in both casual and official contexts to refer to young children in pre-elementary education.

examples.japanese: {園児|えんじ}たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んでいる→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
{園児|えんじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{送|おく}り{迎|むか}え→送り迎え：14362_okurimukae⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧だ。
examples.english: Dropping off and picking up the kindergartener every day is tough.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{幼稚園|ようちえん}→幼稚園：04703_youchien⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{園児|えんじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{弁当|べんとう}→弁当：01014_bentou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{用意|ようい}する→用意する：22428_youisuru⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: At this kindergarten, there are days when the children prepare their own lunch boxes.

notes:
USAGE:
Refers specifically to children enrolled in a ⟦{幼稚園|ようちえん}→幼稚園：04703_youchien⟧ (kindergarten) or ⟦{保育園|ほいくえん}→保育園：04704_hoikuen⟧ (nursery school). Not used for children who simply happen to be young — the word implies enrollment in a pre-school institution.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {園児|えんじ}⟦{募集|ぼしゅう}→募集：03035_boshuu⟧ (recruiting kindergarteners; enrollment call)
- {園児|えんじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{保護者|ほごしゃ}→保護者：11564_hogosha⟧ (guardians of kindergarten children)
- {園児|えんじ}⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧ (number of enrolled children)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{幼児|ようじ}→幼児：12478_youji⟧: young child — broader term for any small child, regardless of school enrollment
- ⟦{児童|じどう}→児童：03340_jidou⟧: school child — refers to elementary school-age children
